notes: «[2/194] رجال الكشي:» is the source label and title, not a transmitter; the chain begins at Muhammad b. Qulawayh
The two isnads both write «ابن أبي عمير» before they meet the shared continuation, so they are two groups with the names written in each (rule 3)
The Imam speaks in the words after «قال علي بن الحسين عليه السلام»: he is the last item, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); «عليه السلام» left out
